Extension of Approval scrutiny

Every document, verified before anyone signs.

CipherCore Verify is a decision-support platform for technical institution approvals. It fingerprints documents, checks them with issuing authorities, audits facilities against APH 2024-27 norms, and leaves the final decision to an officer.

Platform architecture

Four engines. One evidence trail.

Three engines gather evidence. The fourth makes sure a person decides.

Engine 1 of 4 · Forensic Analysis

OCR & forensic tamper check

Autonomous multi-layer PDF parsing engine extracting text streams, font descriptor tables, and embedded raster overlays. Executes Error Level Analysis (ELA: 88.4%) to detect post-issuance digital alterations. Cross-triangulates institutional title, survey numbers, approval dates, and land acreage across all uploaded statutory documents.

Font EncodingsError Level Analysis (88.4%)Cross-Document Entity MatchingPDF Stream Dissection
Engine 2 of 4 · Registry Gateway

Issuing authority gateway

Direct API verification bridge to state repositories and central government authenticators. Validates State Fire Services NOC validity, queries DigiLocker CTS land records for contiguous plot holding, and verifies State Technical University annual affiliation records, eliminating reliance on scanned paper representations.

State Fire Services APIDigiLocker Land RegistryUniversity Affiliation GatewayDSC Token Validation
Engine 3 of 4 · Infrastructure Vision

APH infrastructure audit

Autonomous spatial and physical infrastructure auditor enforcing AICTE Approval Process Handbook (APH 2024–27) Chapter II norms. YOLOv8x computer vision model inspects laboratory workstation counts (1:1 terminal-to-intake norm), computing carpet density (≥1.20 sq.m/terminal), barrier-free access ramps, fire safety equipment, and geofenced coordinates.

APH 2024-27 Chapter IIYOLOv8x Workstation DetectionCarpet Area Density (≥1.20 m²)Geofence HUD (18.52° N)
Engine 4 of 4 · Governance Gate

Statutory human decision gate

Strict advisory architecture ensuring AI never issues automated rejections without human oversight. Empowers authorized AICTE Scrutiny Officers to review forensic evidence, record definitive decisions (Approval, Show-Cause Notice, or Deficiency Order), and digitally sign determinations recorded permanently on a SHA-256 consortium audit ledger.

Human-in-the-Loop GateStatutory Officer Sign-OffSHA-256 Notary LedgerSection 3A IT Act Compliance
01
OCR & forensics

Regulatory verification workflow

From dossier to decision, with the evidence attached.

Step 1 of 4

Dossier ingestion

The application and its six mandatory PDFs enter a secure pipeline. Each file gets a SHA-256 fingerprint on arrival.

Step 2 of 4

Automated triangulation

OCR extracts the fields. Authority adapters check state registries for live status, so every claim is compared with its source.

Step 3 of 4

Anomaly flagging

Discrepancies in dates, acreage, workstation counts or duplicate PANs are highlighted with severity tags, ready for review.

Step 4 of 4

Official sign-off

The officer examines the evidence, records the decision and logs a cryptographic justification that cannot be edited quietly later.

01
Ingestion

APH Section 2.1

The six mandatory EoA documents.

Hover a document to bring its sheet forward in the scene.

  1. 01
    Fire Safety Certificate (NOC) State Fire & Emergency Services issued NOC verified for institutional building height, sprinkler coverage, fire hydrants, and annual renewal validity. Direct adapter check confirms active status in state registry.
    APH Section 2.1.1Annual Renewal CheckRegistry Verified
  2. 02
    Land Ownership Deed & Encumbrance Registered 30-year lease or freehold sale deed proving contiguous land area. Cross-validated against DigiLocker State Revenue CTS property cards; ELA detects survey number and acreage discrepancies.
    APH Section 2.1.2Min Contiguous 2.50 / 5.00 AcresDigiLocker CTS Match
  3. 03
    University Affiliation Letter Annual permanent or provisional affiliation order from affiliating State Technical University validating approved intake capacity, sanctioned branches, and curriculum compliance.
    APH Section 2.1.3Annual Renewal OrderAffiliation Registry
  4. 04
    Faculty Roster & Form 16 / PAN List Certified cadre-wise teaching faculty roster with Principal/Director appointment. Cross-referenced for 1:15 / 1:20 teacher-student ratio, AICTE qualification norms, and duplicate PAN fraud across multiple colleges.
    APH Section 2.1.4Cadre Ratio 1:2:6PAN Duplication Filter
  5. 05
    Municipal Approved Building Plan Competent town planning / municipal corporation sanctioned floor blueprints. Audited against instructional, administrative, and amenities carpet area norms; verified for barrier-free access ramps and safety exits.
    APH Section 2.1.5Instructional Area ≥ 4,200 sq.mMunicipal Sanction
  6. 06
    Fee Payment Receipt (TER Charges) AICTE Technical Education Regulatory (TER) scrutiny and processing fee receipt. Transaction reference, bank UTR number, and institutional PAN cross-checked against AICTE payment gateway reconciliation.
    APH Section 2.1.6Payment Gateway UTRConsortium Ledger Notarized

Statutory safeguard

AI flags are advisory. A person signs.

No auto-rejections without human review.

  • Flags are preliminaryThey support a decision. They are not proof of forgery or non-compliance.
  • Officers decideApprovals, show-cause notices and deficiency orders need an authorised officer's digital signature.
  • Everything is loggedEach action lands in an audit ledger built on SHA-256 hashes.

CipherCore Verify

A prototype built in response to a Smart India Hackathon problem statement. Automated flags are preliminary decision-support outputs. Final approvals, deficiency notices and inspection orders remain with competent human authorities. This is not an official AICTE system.
